title: Module cards + README/PRD docs

steps: Write or update a docs/modules card for every new/changed module listed in the write set, matching the R1 doc-duty format
Update docs/modules/index.json's digest registry for all of them
Update README.md and PRD.md to describe the actual Phase 2 autonomous loop, dashboard, and distribution-signer custody model

notes: Doc duty (R1); trails the functional work packages it describes.
